sourceNote: Files are downloaded into tools/data/raw and ignored by git. This manifest and tools/fetch-content.sh are tracked.

items.title: HSK 3.0 character list, all levels
items.source: Gushi (gushichinese.com), derived from the official HSK 3.0 syllabus, November 2025
items.attribution: HSK 3.0 character list, all levels by Gushi (https://gushichinese.com/hsk-3.0/downloads), CC BY-SA 4.0
items.note: Primary Chinese character list. Levels 1-9. Pinyin, tones, meaning, example.

items.title: HSK 3.0 word list, all levels
items.attribution: HSK 3.0 word list, all levels by Gushi (https://gushichinese.com/hsk-3.0/downloads), CC BY-SA 4.0
items.note: Read-only word context and HSK level lookup. Never scheduled.

items.title: HSK 3.0 characters with Traditional forms and writing flags
items.attribution: ivankra/hsk30 (MIT); data derived from elkmovie/hsk30 and the official syllabus
items.note: Cross-check list. WritingLevel non-empty marks the 1,200-character writing set; Traditional column builds the variant table.

items.title: Make Me a Hanzi graphics
items.attribution: Make Me a Hanzi by Shaunak Kishore; graphics derived from Arphic PL KaitiM GB and Arphic PL UKai
items.note: Stroke SVG paths and medians for Chinese characters.

items.title: Make Me a Hanzi dictionary
items.attribution: Make Me a Hanzi by Shaunak Kishore; dictionary derived from Unihan and CJKlib
items.note: Definitions and decomposition for Chinese characters.

items.title: KanjiVG stroke diagrams
items.note: Per-kanji SVG stroke order for Japanese. Extract with unzip.

items.title: KANJIDIC2
items.source: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG)
items.note: Readings, meanings, grade. Jōyō filter (grades 1-6 and 8) yields 2136 kanji.

items.title: CC-CEDICT
items.note: Chinese word context. Read-only, never scheduled.

items.title: Unihan Database
items.note: Variant relations, radicals, Korean education Hanja, definitions, and stroke counts.

items.title: JMdict (English)
items.note: Japanese word examples. Used in v1.
